Name: -AT- Cosmics Stupid But Cute Cats
Author: cosmiccatt
Description:
Simply download the main file, extract it into your molds folder, and youre good to go! To see the textures in game, you need to buy the scissors item from Robin <3 
Cats include: Sphynx with big or dot eyes, Ginger cat with dot eyes, Birman cat with big or dot eyes, Black cat, Void cat, and Scottish fold cat with big or dot eyes! :3
